title: Zapier Professional to self-hosted n8n
summary: Zapier bills by task volume; n8n on your own box does not. The crossover depends on how much you automate, not how many people you employ.

you_lose: Zapier's 8,000+ prebuilt integrations; n8n has a few hundred plus generic HTTP
Someone else fixing an integration when a vendor changes their API
Zero-maintenance reliability — a failed workflow at 3am is now your pager
you_gain: Unmetered task volume, which is the whole point if you run high-frequency automations
Arbitrary JavaScript in a workflow without paying for a higher tier
Data that never leaves your server, which matters for regulated workloads

caveats: n8n's licence is a fair-code Sustainable Use Licence, not OSI open source. Self-hosting for your own internal use is permitted; reselling it as a service is not.
The $19.99 Zapier figure is the entry tier. If you are over its task allowance your real bill is higher and n8n wins sooner than this page shows.
Rebuilding Zaps is manual — there is no importer. The 8-hour estimate assumes roughly a dozen workflows.
